tytul: Uncooked strawberry jam for the refrigerator or freezer (NCHFP)
wstep: This card describes the NCHFP recipe for uncooked strawberry jam with powdered pectin: the fruit is not cooked and the jam is not canned; it keeps up to 3 weeks in the refrigerator or up to a year in a freezer.

akapity: For about 5–6 half-pint jars: 2 cups crushed strawberries (about 1 quart, about 0.95 l, of berries), 4 cups sugar, 1 package powdered pectin and 1 cup water.
Sterilize canning jars and prepare two-piece canning lids according to the manufacturer’s directions.
Sort and wash fully ripe strawberries, drain them, remove caps and stems, then crush the berries.
Mix the crushed berries well with the sugar and let stand for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Dissolve the pectin in the water and boil for 1 minute.
Add the pectin solution to the berry-and-sugar mixture and stir for 2 minutes.
Pour the jam into freezer containers or canning jars, leaving 1/2 inch (about 1.3 cm) headspace.
Close the containers and let them stand at room temperature for 24 hours.
Then store the jam up to 3 weeks in the refrigerator or up to a year in a freezer.
Do not keep uncooked jam at room temperature: it will mold or ferment in a short time.
Keep an opened container in the refrigerator and use the jam within a few days.
